subject: Orbit AI: regional dedicated GPU pool ask (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Jack Lin <jack.lin@orbitai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Capacity planning for upcoming pilot

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Orbit AI is ready to move a small pilot into production in APAC and EU and we need help sizing dedicated capacity. High-level ask: we want regional dedicated pools (APAC primary, EU for data residency, and a small US pool for redundancy/analytics) for a 3-month pilot with option to convert to a reserved commit.

Model details: single coder/assistant model (70B, quantized 4-bit), inference pattern is mostly short prompts with occasional 1-2k token generation. Expected steady-state QPS: ~25 across regions with 50 peak bursts. Latency target: p95 < 300ms for short prompts.

Can you provide a recommended GPU pool breakdown (instance types and counts per region), expected provisioning lead time, and a ballpark cost estimate? Also please advise on burst options and whether we should start with shared/dedicated or dedicated right away.

Attached: pilot_requirements_v2.pdf (short requirements doc).

Cheers,
Jack
VP Engineering, Orbit AI
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Jack Lin <jack.lin@orbitai.com>
Cc: Sofia Hughes <sofia@orbitai.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T12:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Capacity planning for upcoming pilot

Jack — thanks for the clear brief. We can definitely support a regional dedicated approach. Quick clarifying questions so we size appropriately:

- Is the 25 QPS steady per-region or global (i.e., 25 in APAC + 25 EU + 25 US)?
- Do you require strict data residency in EU (no cross-region fallback)?
- Any specific SLA/uptime targets beyond the latency p95?

I want to loop in Karthik (solutions) and Marissa (capacity planning) to give a preliminary sizing and cost. After that we can schedule a 30-min call to agree timelines and whether to include burst capacity.

Next steps: I’ll send a preliminary pool proposal by EOD Tuesday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T08:05:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Capacity planning for upcoming pilot — Orbit AI (prelim sizing request)

Team — forwarding Orbit's ask (below). Key constraints: 70B quantized to 4-bit, steady ~25 QPS, 50 peak bursts; APAC first, EU for residency, US small. They want a 3-month pilot with option to convert to a commit.

High-level thoughts (please comment inline):
- APAC (primary): Start with 8 x A100-80GB equiv (can be mapped to 4x H100 for higher perf) giving steady throughput for ~25 QPS with headroom for batching and KV-cache. Rationale: APAC demand and lower tolerance for cold starts.
- EU (residency): 4 x A100-80GB (hot pool) + 2 x A100 as burst nodes behind autoscaler. If strict residency required, configure routing policy to avoid cross-region fallback.
- US (fallback/analytics): 2 x A100 reserved; keep shared capacity option if cost is a concern.

Operational options to propose in quote:
- Dedicated reserved commit (monthly) vs Dedicated ephemeral with burst to shared hosted when needed.
- Autoscaling policy: maintain min hot nodes; allow 2x burst for 15-minute windows.
- Quantization + model shard strategy: recommend 4-bit with KV cache pinned to reduce per-token cost; our optimize team can run evals.

Questions for infra: provisioning lead time for new APAC pool if we need H100 vs A100? Any constraints on locking dedicated GPUs for a 3-month pilot?

Attaching my preliminary spreadsheet (prelim_fleet_sizing.csv) — includes rough cost calc and latency estimates. Please review and update sizing by EOD tomorrow; we need to send to Orbit before their exec sync on Friday.

Thanks — Neha
From: Sofia Hughes <sofia@orbitai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Jack Lin <jack.lin@orbitai.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T10:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Capacity planning for upcoming pilot

Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround and the internal loop. Answers to your clarifying questions:

- The 25 QPS figure is per-region (APAC will see ~25 steady).
- EU requires strict residency for EU customers (no cross-region processing for EU traffic).
- Uptime: standard enterprise expectation (99.9%) for the pilot; we can clarify SLA in the contract.

Budget note: this is an early-stage pilot so we need a tight cost conversation. We favor dedicated pools if the unit economics work, otherwise a hybrid with guaranteed hot nodes + burst to shared is acceptable.

We can do a call Wednesday 2026-02-19 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET to go over the preliminary numbers. Also confirming the model is the 70B quantized artifact; we will share a sample workload to run your Optimize recommendations.

DocuSign/contracting will be handled by our procurement team after we agree on sizing and price.

Thanks,
Sofia
Head of Product, Orbit AI
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-22T16:40:00Z
Subject: Orbit AI pilot — agreed prelim plan & next steps

Team — summary from call and Orbit confirmation (Sofia confirmed per-region QPS and residency):

Decisions: 
- APAC: Provision 6 x H100-equivalent nodes (preferred for token-level p95 reduction) as the hot dedicated pool. Configure autoscaler to allow +3 burst nodes from our shared pool for short peaks.
- EU: 4 x A100-80GB hot nodes + 2 x A100 burst nodes; strict routing policy to enforce residency.
- US: 2 x A100 reserved nodes (low-cost standby), with ability to route non-EU/non-APAC analytics traffic.
- Commit: 3-month pilot priced as a reserved capacity (monthly invoice) with option to convert to a 12-month reserved contract at a discounted rate.

Action items:
- Marissa: finalize provisioning timeline & confirm whether we need physical lead time for H100 in APAC (ETA by EOD Monday).
- Karthik: prepare commercial quote and outline hybrid vs fully dedicated pricing by Thursday. Include burst pricing and an example SLO clause for residency.
- Rishi: put pre-provision hold on capacity and open a ticket with infra for autoscaler config; include KV-cache prewarm playbook.
- Neha: send Orbit the fleet_estimate_q2.xlsx (attached) and schedule contracting touchpoint with procurement.

Attachments: fleet_estimate_q2.xlsx (prelim quote), prelim_fleet_sizing.csv (internal calc), pilot_requirements_v2.pdf (customer brief).

I’ll update HubSpot with the action items and attach the call notes. We should aim to have capacity online for a soft launch within 3 weeks if the APAC procurement for H100 is on schedule.

Neha
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
